name: Enomoto Chisato
source:
A cheerful and kind school nurse. She is popular with students.

After she realizes that the protagonist is her childhood friend, she starts doting on him intensely, perhaps because of nostalgia for those times. She is physically very intimate towards people who she is close to.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc086/index.html#character]Official Site[/url]]
